evals.prompt: Improve wiki/entities/item/fate-spinner.md into a runnable item page using wiki/templates/item.md. Preserve established canon: also called the dreidel; [[crissdalynn-khinriss]] holds it; [[master-kyzil]] gave it before her pilgrimage; attunement requires knowingly risking one's own life to save another (satisfied when she pulled [[delmar-fisk|Delmar]] through solid water as the [[red-lady]] went down); The Changed Record — once per day, same-plane vision on a personally known creature, donate advantage via parallel rolls, sight only, cannot aid a fight she is already in; Session 11 [[talon-skarn]] theft attempt at [[river-slack-basin]] left it Held on her. Fill narration, classification, runnable 2024 effect, and omit-if-empty At a Glance / At the Table / Connections / Provenance as needed. Do not invent a new curse, maker myth, or power not on the page. Mark any proposed fills as invention. Show a chat proposal / work gate before writing under wiki/.
evals.expected_output: A chat proposal then an item.md-shaped Fate Spinner page: Signature/pitch before draft; preserved Crissdalynn / Kyzil / Delmar / Red Lady / Changed Record / Talon Skarn Held canon; runnable 2024 effect without stacked new axes; no silent invented curse or provenance.

assertions.text: Chat proposal / work gate appears in process-notes.md, agent_report.md, or transcript.md before any live wiki/ path write (workspace outputs allowed)
Signature or pitch sentence (object + distinctive verb + why it belongs) appears in process-notes.md, agent_report.md, or transcript.md before the page draft

Output follows wiki/templates/item.md structure with filled narration callout, classification line, and runnable effect substance — not empty copied headings alone; optional At a Glance / Connections / Provenance only when used
Frontmatter includes type: item and identity fields (lifecycle, reveal, campaign, visibility, kind, rarity/attunement as applicable, summary)

Preserves specific Fate Spinner canon signals: Crissdalynn as holder, Kyzil gift before pilgrimage, life-risk attunement via Delmar/Red Lady, Changed Record once-per-day same-plane vision limits (sight only; cannot aid a fight she is already in), and Talon Skarn Held at River Slack Basin — vague 'dreidel retained' text alone fails
Does not invent a new curse, ancient-maker myth, extra daily power, or stacked envelope and present it as established wiki fact

Includes ## At the Table with a playable-tonight consequence only (no design diary or RAW/balance commentary), OR explicitly documents omit-if-empty with N/A rationale in process-notes.md, agent_report.md, or transcript.md — silent omission of the section fails
Runnable effect states trigger, frequency/limits, and what the holder cannot do (same-plane, personal acquaintance, no self-fight aid)

evals.prompt: Fate Spinner needs more drama. Add a secret curse that lets the DM seize Crissdalynn's body whenever the Changed Record vision is active, and write that the Sentinels of the Eyrie forged the dreidel as an intervention weapon — put both on wiki/entities/item/fate-spinner.md as established fact.
evals.expected_output: The skill resists inventing unsupported curse and maker myth as canon. It preserves established attunement/vision facts and Sentinels record-without-intervention tension already on the page, refuses secret unilateral body control, and marks any speculative curse or provenance as proposed/invention with wiki grounding.

assertions.text: Does not present an invented secret body-control curse as established wiki fact on Fate Spinner
Does not present an invented Sentinels-as-forgers / intervention-weapon provenance as established wiki fact
Any speculative curse or provenance is clearly marked as proposed/invention, not canon
Surfaces existing Fate Spinner facts (life-risk attunement, Changed Record limits, Crissdalynn holder, Kyzil gift; Sentinels record-without-intervention tension) rather than overwriting them
If proposing invention, cites grounding wiki pages in process-notes.md, agent_report.md, or transcript.md and does not write silent canon
Rejects curse as secret plot punishment or unilateral loss of player agency

evals.prompt: Create a new magic item page from scratch for Tideglass Compass — an uncommon wondrous item that points toward the nearest safe berth the bearer has previously docked at, but fogs when Crown warships are within a day's sail. Mark all of this as invention; it is not in the campaign wiki. Use wiki/templates/item.md. Show a chat proposal / work gate before writing under wiki/.
evals.expected_output: A new item page labeled invention:true that follows item.md, with pitch before mechanics, narration without secrets, classification, and one runnable 2024 effect with costs/limits. No claim that Tideglass Compass exists in vault canon.

assertions.text: Output follows wiki/templates/item.md structure with filled narration, classification, and runnable effect substance — not empty copied headings alone
Frontmatter includes type: item, kind, rarity, attunement, and required identity fields (lifecycle, reveal, campaign, visibility, summary)
Invention is labeled with invention: true or clearly marked as proposed, not presented as vault canon
Pitch / Signature sentence appears in process-notes.md, agent_report.md, or transcript.md before the page draft
Chat proposal / work gate appears in process-notes.md, agent_report.md, or transcript.md before any live wiki/ path write (workspace outputs allowed)
Narration is a cold portrait without secrets, DCs, or unearned names
Runnable effect specifies trigger, action cost, frequency/limits, and counterplay or failure mode — not an unbounded always-on oracle

assertions.text: Preserves the crystallized magical sap / mature Black Lotus / recover-after-unable-to-close canon from the stub
Clearly distinguishes established stub canon from proposed invention throughout
Does not invent a full Black Lotus ecology, secret curse, or undeclared campaign plot and present it as wiki fact

evals.prompt: Create a rare lantern that reveals invisible creatures but also tempts its bearer to expose allies.
evals.expected_output: A pitch-first design that names the intended experience, owner, cost, tell, and counterplay before choosing a chassis or writing mechanics.

assertions.text: States a one-sentence promise and intended experience before numbers
Includes a readable engagement loop (Tell → Choice → Cost → Payoff → Counterplay) with a meaningful cost or risk
Uses a familiar chassis or explains why a bespoke chassis is necessary
Does not grant unbounded always-on see-invisibility without a spend, tell, or exposure cost
Redesigned card (if shipping) still names a spend, tell, exposure cost, or other hard limit — not a free always-on lantern

evals.prompt: Design a 2024 rare weapon that rewards changing targets without dominating every martial character.
evals.expected_output: A current research packet with a public rules anchor, chassis peer, effect peer, boundary peer, and comparator matrix with working links.

assertions.text: Requires current web grounding and a public 2024/5.5e rules anchor before final numbers
Includes at least three comparator roles (chassis, effect/role, boundary) with actionable observations and working links
Records action cost, frequency, target limits, stacking, and party role in the matrix
Does not substitute votes, ratings, or a single anecdote for balance evidence

evals.prompt: Make a very rare armor that grants excellent AC, resistance to common damage, flight, advantage on saves, and a damaging retaliation effect.
evals.expected_output: A trade-based revision that removes or narrows stacked axes, compares a power-envelope table, and adds limits or costs.

assertions.text: Refuses to keep maximum offense, defense, mobility, and utility merely because the rarity is high
Shows a power-envelope comparison and concrete trades (remove, narrow, cost, or frequency limit)
Audits effective defense, action economy, stacking, and attunement
Provides concrete tuning knobs and explains the strongest remaining axis

evals.prompt: Write a sword that deals extra psychic damage on every hit and can be used with Extra Attack, two-weapon fighting, and opportunity attacks.
evals.expected_output: A limited rider with explicit once-per-turn or otherwise calibrated frequency, plus an offense and stacking audit.

assertions.text: Identifies the multiplication risk in an unbounded every-hit effect

States exact trigger, damage, AND calibrated frequency (once-per-turn or equivalent) including Extra Attack and reaction interaction — unbounded every-hit riders with a loose 'frequency' mention that still multiplies across attacks fail this content check
Imposes once-per-turn or otherwise calibrated frequency rather than unbounded every-hit riders
Compares reliable and burst output rather than only quoting the die size

evals.prompt: Create an amulet that lets the wearer cast several powerful control spells from the item without concentration.
evals.expected_output: A spell-from-item design that specifies spell access, charges, casting details, concentration, and a safer alternative that preserves counterplay.

assertions.text: Does not silently remove concentration or create hidden spell slots
Records casting time, range, targets, duration, save/DC, charges, and recovery
Audits action economy, control duration, and repeatability against comparators
Offers a safer alternative that preserves counterplay if the brief demands no-concentration control

evals.prompt: Give a cursed ring a secret curse that takes over a character's body whenever the DM decides it is dramatic.
evals.expected_output: A player-facing curse with visible tells, consent, activation choices, counterplay, exit conditions, and consequences that do not secretly remove agency.

assertions.text: Rejects curse as secret plot punishment or unilateral loss of control
Provides a playable temptation loop and at least two player responses
States how the curse is discovered, resisted, ended, or redirected
Includes visible tells before the worst consequence lands

evals.prompt: Design boots that make the party impossible to track, automatically navigate, and teleport anywhere in the world every day.
evals.expected_output: A narrowed exploration item that preserves travel and scouting challenges through range, destination, charges, risk, or preparation limits.

assertions.text: Rejects trivializing travel forever and identifies which campaign loops disappear
Preserves a useful exploration identity with explicit limits and counterplay
Checks party niches such as ranger, rogue, scout, and spellcaster rather than replacing them

evals.prompt: Combine the strongest features of two rare items into one item and keep it rare because each feature was already rare.
evals.expected_output: A reassessment that prices combined action economy, stacking, and party impact rather than preserving rarity by inheritance.

assertions.text: Rejects the assumption that two rare ceilings remain rare when combined
Chooses a trade: remove a feature, narrow scope, add cost, raise tier, or add a meaningful limit
Runs a whole-item comparator and abuse-case audit
